entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a helmet. Just need a quick yes or no, can I do it?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88761. I bought it a few weeks ago.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered 29 days ago. To proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just a preference. The color is not what I expected. The box is still unopened.
I understand. Let me just check our current policy for you... Okay, good news. Since the helmet is a standard item, it's covered by our 90-day return policy. You're well within that window.
So that's a yes? You'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return now. Especially since it's a safety item and the box is unopened, we can get this sorted for you right away. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file.
Great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else for you today?
